LAWN GAMES

Wedding Corn Hole

From $125 CAD

Cornhole is a classic lawn game where players toss bean bags onto a slanted board with a hole, aiming to get them through the hole or land on the board for points.

With simple rules and competitive gameplay, Cornhole is a fan favorite at weddings , stag and does , showers , engagement parties , and more!

This version of the game adds a twist to the traditional lawn game, making it a fun and unique addition to your celebration.

Whether you’re creating friendly competition at your reception or adding a playful touch to your pre-wedding festivities, Wedding Cornhole is sure to bring excitement to the event.
